entities.summary: "Kiss Kiss Goodbye" is a song by Slovak singer-songwriter Adonxs. It was written by Adonxs, George Masters-Clark, Ines Coulon, Lorenzo Calvo, Michaela Charvátová and Ronald Janeček. The acoustic version was first presented on 4 February 2025 while the studio version was released on 7 March. It represented Czechia in the Eurovision Song Contest 2025.
